$schema_note: Plan + live progress for the PDBbind-Benchmark RSNN_TRSF vs GET task. Machine-readable companion to the Asana dashboard. Keep last_updated current; update phase.status + artifacts after each stage.

task.name: run Transformer RSNN + dihedral features on Atom3D Dataset

goal: Run the transformer RSNN (RSNN_TRSF_Reg) with dihedral features on a protein-ligand binding-affinity dataset and compare, at matched parameter budget, against GET (THUNLP-MT/GET). Modular so the same backbone can run many datasets.

locked_decisions.dataset: PDBbind-Benchmark, identity30 split (NOT Atom3D LBA). Zenodo 8102783 -> GET process_PDBbind_benchmark.py -> datasets/PDBBind/processed/identity30/{train,valid,test}.pkl.
locked_decisions.sequence_construction: All-atom. Protein atoms in deterministic residue order (N->C, canonical within residue) as a shared prefix, then m random ligand DFS walks each concatenated onto that prefix (within-walk attention captures binding interaction).
locked_decisions.get_baseline: Native recipe as coded (PDBBind/identity30_get.json: max_epoch 20, lr 1e-4, hidden64/radial64/3L/4H/k9). No extended training.
locked_decisions.compute: SLURM dym-lab: request 6 A40 GPUs, fewer if unavailable. After primary comparison, run more Atom3D datasets starting with PPI (likely GET PPA, protein-protein affinity, 176 complexes; confirm mapping).
locked_decisions.param_match: RSNN_TRSF_Reg tuned to GET PDBbind-config trainable param count 719,356 within +/-5% => target range [683388, 755324]. (LESSONS.md h128/nl3 transformer=774,433 is +7.7%, so shrink slightly, e.g. h_dim~116-120 or nl2.) GET count script: GET/scripts/exps/_count_params_identity30.py.

resolved_facts.model_name: RSNN_TRSF_Reg (regression), quickstart/train_qm9.py:238. NOT legacy classification RSNN_TRSF in models/rwnn.py (wrong nhead + sigmoid).
resolved_facts.dihedral_features: Already implemented + used in QM9 transformer sweep: per-walk-step quadruplet stream (utils/search.py) + GeometricAttentionBias (models/seq_encoder.py). Only wired for single small molecules with data.pos; helpers reusable.
resolved_facts.split_flag_resolution: identity30_split.json (what the code loads) = 3507/466/490 (train/valid/test) = 4463 selected from the 4709-complex affinities.json pool. Resolves App.D.5 (3507/466/490) vs Table 9 (3563/448/452): code uses App.D.5 numbers.
resolved_facts.graph_recipe: OUR model: nodes=atoms; edges between all atom pairs < 4.5 A; edge weight w=1/d+eps (eps=1e-5); node features one-hot atom type. (Atom3D/Townshend recipe, followed literally.) GET uses its own KNN block graph (k=9, RBF cutoff 7.0) - each model builds its own graph on the same complexes.
resolved_facts.metrics: Pearson, Spearman, RMSE, MAE (GET evaluate.py standard for PLA/PDBBind).

environments.rwnn: torch 2.4.0+cu121, pyg 2.6.1, torch_cluster 1.6.3, rdkit. Used for RSNN model + our data reader (no GET/biopython dependency).
environments.GET: torch 1.13.1+cu117, atom3d 0.2.6, e3nn, biopython 1.80, biopandas, mmseqs2. From GET/env.yml. Used to process raw PDBbind -> .pkl and to run GET. STATUS: building.

slurm_jobs.what: GET native baseline (exps_3.py, 20 epochs x3 seeds)

results.head_to_head_standard: GET wins all 4 metrics by a modest margin (Pearson 0.5887 vs 0.5516 = +0.037/+6.7% rel; RMSE 1.375 vs 1.440). As expected: equivariant/hierarchical GET > plain transformer, but close. Param-matched (692,009 vs 719,356, -3.8%).

dropout0.1.note: BEST single-seed; BEATS GET (0.5887)! best_epoch~89. single-seed -> needs 3-seed confirm

confirmation_3seed.verdict: STATISTICAL PARITY, not a win. The seed42 single-seed 'beat' (dropout0.1 0.5995 > GET) was noise -> regressed to the mean. dropout0.1 3-seed (P 0.5847) is indistinguishable from GET (0.5887): error bars overlap on all 4 metrics; GET edges Pearson/RMSE, the transformer edges Spearman (0.5689 vs 0.5641) & MAE (1.1121 vs 1.1316) -> 2/4 each. sinusoidal (0.5787) similar. The ~6% standard-config gap essentially vanishes with dropout. HEADLINE: a param-matched plain transformer with dropout MATCHES equivariant GET on PDBbind identity30; 'beats' is NOT supported.

results.grid_conclusion: On seed42, positional-encoding choice matters more than the equivariance gap: sinusoidal PE (0.5941) reaches GET parity (0.5887) while rope-standard is 0.5611 and causal attention is worst (0.5310). Recommend a 3-seed confirmation of sinusoidal (and dropout0.1 once it finishes) before any headline claim. Core head-to-head (standard config, 3 seeds) already answered: GET wins ~6%.
results.task_status: CORE DELIVERABLE COMPLETE (GET vs RSNN_TRSF head-to-head, param-matched, 3 seeds). Grid 6/7 done; dropout0.1 finishing.

GET: GET/evaluate.py output / models/GET/*/ per-seed -> Pearson/Spearman/RMSE/MAE. Compare standard config (3-seed mean+/-std) vs GET (3-seed). Both param-matched (~692k vs 719,356).
